name: dndgpt-system-rebirth
description: A custom D&D-inspired RPG with ChatGPT as your GM and a persistent campaign dashboard.

interface.longDescription: A heavily customized, D&D-inspired RPG built around Deon Holo's taste in fantasy games. ChatGPT runs the adventure using DnDGPT's own rules, classes and progression. The complete rulebook and Rule Hardener are included. Build your character, explore, and track your abilities, allies, inventory, quests and story in a saved dashboard.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use DnDGPT's included rules. Do not start or resume any campaign until I explicitly authorize it.
